name: Sunnydaze Decor Northland Grill Fire Pit with Protective Cover - NB-NW201
description: Dimensions: 36L x 27W x 25H in.; Bowl depth: 5 in.. Includes spark screen, grilling grate, fire tool, and protective cover. Heavy-duty steel construction. For wood fires. Temperature-resistant black finish. Add wood to the Sunnydaze Decor Northland Grill Fire Pit with Protective Cover and enjoy the warmth and light of a fire safely for hours. The heavy-duty steel fire pit has a mesh guard to protect you from stray sparks, and a hinged access door still lets you tend the fire with ease using the included multi-function tool. With the removable cooking grate, you can convert the fire pit to a grill and cook over the flames. Full-perimeter handles make the 30-pound fire pit simple to lift, carry, and empty. A reinforced vinyl cover protects the fire pit from debris and weather between uses.
